name: Cheryl Mason
source:
Cheryl Mason is the adopted daughter of Harry Mason. She disappears after Harry crashes his car upon arriving in the town, and finding her becomes his primary objective throughout the game.

[Partially from [url=https://silenthill.fandom.com/wiki/Cheryl_Mason]Silent Hill Wiki[/url]]
